Theorem
[Short time existence---complete with bounded curvature] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0384 1. appD:D.2\group Ricci Flow Existence

If $(\mathcal M^n,g_0)$ is complete, noncompact, and has bounded sectional curvature, then it admits a complete Ricci flow $g(t)$, $t\in [0,T)$, with $g(0)=g_0$ and sectional curvature bounded on compact time intervals.
